comment: Major missing requirement: metadata-driven configuration and platform extensibility. The requirements specify indicators, analytics, APIs and offline use but not the capability to configure datasets, forms, programmes, organisational units, roles, validation/workflow rules and dashboards without modifying core code; reuse governed metadata packages across programmes; support aggregate, event and registered person/cohort data in one platform; or extend the platform through open APIs/apps. These are central to DHIS2’s ability to serve as adaptable national infrastructure at subnational levels.

public.text: Major missing requirement: metadata-driven configuration and platform extensibility. The requirements specify indicators, analytics, APIs and offline use but not the capability to configure datasets, forms, programmes, organisational units, roles, validation/workflow rules and dashboards without modifying core code; reuse governed metadata packages across programmes; support aggregate, event and registered person/cohort data in one platform; or extend the platform through open APIs/apps. These are central to DHIS2’s ability to serve as adaptable national infrastructure at subnational levels.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a Required ‘metadata-driven, multi-modal and extensible platform’ capability. The HMIS shall separate core software code from governed configuration; support reusable/versioned metadata packages and national localisation; manage aggregate, event and registered cohort data with explicit linkage/aggregation rules; expose complete documented APIs and an app-extension model; and preserve configuration through upgrades. Cite DHIS2 as an illustrative implementation.
